capabilities: Sync flashcards from notes to Anki decks via AnkiConnect
Parse cards with an AST so delimiters in code, math, and embeds are ignored
Show per-card sync status badges and diagnostics in the Live Preview editor
Resolve block transclusions and upload embedded media to Anki
Detect duplicate and orphaned cards and offer safe resolution options
extras: Anki Desktop must be running locally during sync, and AnkiConnect's CORS config must include Obsidian. Also installable via BRAT as a beta plugin. Includes a headless CLI (runs via Bun) for CI/CD sync independent of Obsidian.
motivation: The author built it because traditional flashcard sync tools rely on fragile regular expressions and reformat notes; an AST-based parser understands true syntactic structure and keeps Markdown files pristine.
problem: Regex-based Obsidian-to-Anki sync tools break on nested code blocks, math, callouts, and embeds, and re-serialize Markdown files, destroying the user's formatting.

relations.evidence: A deterministic, AST-powered synchronization pipeline and Obsidian plugin bridging Obsidian and Anki.
Sync flashcards directly to Anki using an AST markdown engine via AnkiConnect.

summary: Flashcard sync plugin that parses Markdown notes into an AST and syncs cards to Anki via AnkiConnect without reformatting the source files.
